_rederive_removed: This manifest had a rederive that read the LIVE board and asserted every claim row is keyed task_id/task_title and never id/title. It PASSED (4 claim rows, all correct) and is the reason the fix is known to be right. It was then removed rather than kept, because the same session released all four of those claims, so the board now has no claim rows and the check refuses: 'no claim rows on the live board, so this proves nothing today'. That refusal is the check working. The wrong fix would be to take a claim purely so the gate has something to read, which is staging evidence for your own check. The third kind here is `live`, and the rederive's one passing run is recorded in the pull request.
